query: Please implement a data visualization and order system for data analysis and statistics. The system should have functionalities for data visualization, report statistics, self-service BI analysis, and data reporting. Users should be able to log in, browse and analyze data, create and manage reports, perform data visualization, and conduct self-service BI analysis. Implement moccasin for the page background and sandy brown for the elements.
